name: Biology PhD
summary: PhD in Biology in WSU's School of Biological Sciences. Students are admitted to work with a specific faculty advisor, without rotations, so reaching out to faculty before applying is key.
detailsNote: The deadlines below are published without a year, so they are not confirmed for Fall 2027 and are not used in countdowns. The application fee amount is not stated on the pages checked, so it is left out.

publishedDeadlines.label: Priority deadline, Fall (program page)
publishedDeadlines.note: Listed as the priority deadline on the Graduate School's degree page; no year is stated. Confirm Fall 2027 directly.

publishedDeadlines.label: School of Biological Sciences priority date
publishedDeadlines.dateText: December 10th for priority or at the latest by January 10
publishedDeadlines.note: From the School's application advice; no year is stated. The earlier date is safer. Confirm Fall 2027 directly.

english.note: Program page listing on the Graduate School site. The Graduate School's own minimums are lower (iBT 75, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 105; 4 on the new TOEFL iBT scale effective Jan. 21, 2026) and it says programs may require higher scores. Exemptions exist, e.g. a US degree or a degree taught in English. Send TOEFL scores to WSU code 4705.

documents: Online application to the Graduate School
Transcripts sent directly to the Graduate School
requirements.note: The School says it does not require the GRE but looks for a minimum GPA of 3.0. Applications are only considered if three letters are available; at least two should ideally come from faculty. Fee waivers: the Graduate School says McNair Scholars qualify and other requests go to the degree program; it does not say whether international applicants qualify.

funding.note: The School says it tries to provide 6 years (12 semesters) of support for PhD students without a master's and 5 years with one, usually as a teaching assistantship at 20 hours per week with tuition and healthcare coverage. Extensions are possible but not guaranteed. The Graduate School page lists 35 of 35 students in the program with assistantships. It does not say all admitted students are funded or whether this covers international students.

international.note: International applicants must show English proficiency and note the Graduate School deadlines.
